name: AWS Application Migration Service
overview: AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) supports lift-and-shift migration of source servers to AWS using continuous block-level replication and test/cutover workflows.
examSignals: Rehost server workloads to AWS with minimal conversion: Application Migration Service

compareWith.diff: MGN focuses on one-time migration/cutover to AWS; DRS focuses on ongoing disaster recovery readiness and recovery drills.
